apiFindings: create_artist location is a HARD REQUIRED field. Omitting it returns an input validation error, not LOCATION_UNRESOLVABLE. An act with no findable town cannot be created at all. This blocked 5 of the 9 U WOT M8 acts.
create_artist silently dropped facebookUrl, profileImageUrl, actType, genres and nameVariants again on all 4 creates. Every field re-applied via edit_artist and verified with get_by_id.
The backend same-name-same-region uniqueness gate correctly bounced Acoustic Anarchy and told me to use the existing record.
edit_artist accepted a macron in the artist name (Desekrāted) without complaint.
